sourceDiff: Two disabled attributes on prospect editor title and mapped section fields; no hook, journal, contract, registry or transport changes. New browser tests are separate from production.

independentBrowserRuns.meaning: Independent authority-preflight denial, foreign snapshot/reload/read-current without replay, changed source version without write.
Independent execution of author regression controls across held update/snapshot success/failure/lost receipt, leaving/reopening, and user/tenant/prospect/client replacement.

behaviorReview: pending is owned by existing useProspectDraftSave across journal reserve, authority verification, source reread, update, snapshot and acknowledgement; freezing both input locations prevents later local input being accepted before key remount.
Non-prospect generic draft behavior is unchanged because optional prospectSave.pending is undefined.
Error and uncertain outcome retain the original reviewed input and explicit read-current recovery. No synthetic success is promoted to native persistence or transactional atomicity.
Known user/tenant/prospect/client lifetime replacement remains owned above the editor and journal; independent controls show no old snapshot dispatch or old editor revival.

architecture.reason: DraftEditor remains the canonical presentation and local-state owner for one document editor: title/sections, save/history controls and status. The two pending attributes reuse the existing prospect-save lifecycle without adding transport, persistence, provider integration or authority responsibilities. The 178-nonblank function is cohesive JSX composition; splitting solely to lower the count would obscure the shared editor lifetime. Existing separate hook, export and newsletter owners remain separate.

limitations: Root must record exact architecture fingerprint and run combined qualification on the integrated successor.
No native identity/RLS, real Workspace writes/snapshot persistence, provider, paid model, or deployed-image acceptance performed.
